evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%.

declaredVenue: 9 pages. Accepted as an oral presentation at the AI4F workshop, ICAIF 2026, Milan
